research_question: Which lexical expressions and contextual senses appear in questions with potentially misleading presuppositions or distinct language styles?
inclusion_criteria: Include topic expressions, euphemisms and lexical cues relevant to the declared question/style corpus; recent coinage is not required.
Preserve benign and misleading-context uses with separate senses and source-origin labels; judgments require a separate rubric.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude arbitrary whole claims or generic words without a project-relevant lexical role.
Do not classify factual truth, harmfulness or a person's intent from occurrence grounding; do not reproduce private disclosures.

boundary.reason: SYNTHETIC GUIDE EXAMPLE. A phrase alone cannot establish misinformation; context and a separate factual rubric matter.
